text: Portable EyeLink ASC implementation is complete and locally verified: task-level byte/path import, exact SHA-256 and EDF2ASC receipts, lossless stateful framing, block/session materialization, sample/native-event/message timelines, events-only sessions, portable conformance/parity/mutation artifacts, bounded-memory performance court, and a task-first guide. Evidence on 2026-08-20: ioJVM 191/191, ioJS 167/167, full testAll green with a 3 GiB sbt launcher heap, all boundary/header/format/workflow gates green, and all seven smoke workloads passed under the parser court's separate 256 MiB heap. Release certification remains gated on the licensed EDF Access API/vendor EDF2ASC/permitted real-EDF oracle run; portable proof is not vendor certification.
